items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Well, if I'd make a choice, a contral, only a contral was my favorite drum. From a kid coming up, oh, I didn't mind his drum.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know the past days. Yeah, I know him. I know them good. Who would be your favorite drummers? Are your favorite drummer if you had to make a choice of one or two in the old days? Well, if I'd make a choice, a contral, only a contral was my favorite drum. From a kid coming up, oh, I didn't mind his drum. Yeah, he really knew what he was doing. Well, it's like I said, during that time, everybody had to know them tots, you know. Yeah, they had to know the music. Yeah, they had to know the music. Yeah. Because…
